body:
Have you tested this issue on more than one email server?
What about special characters? Do your subjects have some (sometimes)?
Can you give us an example of 
a) a subject that worked
b) a subject that didn't work

Thanx for ur reply @Marc, There is no special character in the subject line. The subject line contains one employee name with the Job Title. 
E:g - John Smith submitted for CakePHP Developer
Working line -- John Smith submitted for CakePHP Developer
Doesn't work -- Patrece Charles Freeman submitted for Mobile Android app Developer

I found only the issue with the subject length.

How are you sending email? There was recent report of a similar issue reported that contained [suggested fixes](https://cakephp.lighthouseapp.com/projects/42648/tickets/2824) however neither myself nor the reporter could reproduce the original issue. Could you [try this patch](https://github.com/markstory/cakephp/compare/cakephp:master...issue-2824) abd see if it solves the issue you're having?

Got the solution by myself. Simply change the core behavior of Email functionality in Cake Lib. Open \lib\Cake\Network\Email\MailTransport.php and edit line no - 47 as below

```
$this->_mail($to, str_replace(array("\r","\n"), "", $email->subject()), $message, $headers, $params);
```

So, the basic change is to remove "New Line" & "Carriage Return" from Subject text. Whenever our subject text becomes more than 75 characters, framework will automatically put new line in the subject text, which wont work while on sending emails.
Thanx a lot @markstory , just now I saw your patch link. Its cool and very helpful.
So did the patch resolve the issue you were having?
@markstory Before watching your patch, I already got resolved my issue. But, still your patch was very helpful for making clear some of my other doubts.
That's great. But if you could confirm the patch fixes the issue I can apply it and solve the issue for everyone else on the future as well.
Don't hesitate @markstory , you can go with the patch. It will work.
Thanks for the help on this @purnarao. I'll get the modified patch applied.
